slides.headline: the signs whose *january* changes the most, ranked
slides.dek: your sign is in here somewhere

slides.headline: january is quiet. enjoy it before it isn't.
slides.body: mars spends the month in the part of your sky astrologers tie to rest. aquarius season from jan 20 reads as fun and flirting. low stakes, good naps.

slides.headline: the sun sits across from you until jan 20.
slides.body: capricorn season reads as a mirror for you: what do the people close to you actually give back? notice, don't audit.

slides.headline: a first quarter moon in your sign on jan 15.
slides.body: saturn and neptune both sit in aries, and venus trines saturn the same day. a good week to make one promise you can keep.

slides.headline: the romance part of your sky goes into redo.
slides.body: mars turns retrograde in virgo on jan 10, a sign astrologers link to your love life. old flames may flicker. you don't have to relight them.

slides.headline: venus leaves your sign on jan 7.
slides.body: the spotlight on your heart moves on. a last quarter moon in scorpio on jan 29 reads as a clean ending. release, don't haunt.

slides.headline: venus opposes uranus in your sign on jan 9.
slides.body: uranus is retrograde in gemini all month. read jan 9 as someone surprising you. mars retrograde squares your sign, so home plans get redone.

slides.headline: venus walks into your sign on jan 7.
slides.body: you'll read as magnetic and maybe a bit too honest. good month to ask someone out plainly. mars retrograde in virgo slows your work plans.

slides.headline: mars backs up right across from you.
slides.body: mars turns retrograde in virgo, your opposite sign, on jan 10. partners and almost-partners slow down. read it as time to renegotiate, not run.

slides.headline: full moon in your sign on jan 22.
slides.body: jupiter is retrograde in leo all month and the full moon lands there on jan 22. the month asks you to be seen for what you actually want.

slides.headline: the new moon lands in your sign on jan 7.
slides.body: your season, your reset. astrologers read a new moon in your sign as a personal new year. pick the one plan and put a date on it.

slides.headline: mercury, the sun, then an eclipse.
slides.body: mercury enters your sign jan 13, the sun on jan 20, the sun meets pluto there on jan 25, and an annular solar eclipse lands in aquarius on feb 6.

slides.headline: mars turns backwards in your sign.
slides.body: mars stations retrograde at 10° virgo on jan 10 and stays retrograde into spring. read it as a slow, honest redo of how you push. the fix you keep avoiding is the work.

slides.headline: find your rank. *send it* to your #1.
slides.body: it's a reading, not a verdict. save it and check back on jan 31.
